title: Flashscore MCP Server Output
description: This Actor is a Standby MCP server. Structured sports data is returned from MCP tools over Streamable HTTP, not written to a dataset. Authenticate with an Apify API token as a Bearer token.

mcpEndpoint.title: MCP endpoint
mcpEndpoint.description: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. POST JSON-RPC here (initialize, tools/list, tools/call). Tools include list_sports, list_countries, list_leagues, get_league, get_standings, get_results_history, get_upcoming_fixtures, get_news, get_odds, list_archive_seasons, get_historical_standings, get_historical_results, get_match, get_live_matches, get_h2h, get_matches_by_day, and get_team_form. Each tool advertises a JSON output schema derived from the Pydantic response models.

health.title: Health
health.description: JSON health check with status, service name, version, and mcp_endpoint.
